messages:
Emilia (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands reliability segment — putting the RCA + action items here for visibility: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2026-03-ingress-throttle. Please add questions here so leadership can respond.

Sam (VP Eng): TL;DR: ~35m latency incident caused by autoscaler misconfig + cache TTL regression after a weekend deploy. Mitigated via manual scaling + config rollback.

Rohit (SRE Lead): Posted RCA draft with timeline. Missing one cache log snippet — I'll attach by EOD. Also added alert infra:cache-ttl-drift.

Jess (Customer Ops): I'll prepare a short customer note and impacted-account list. Draft ETA: tomorrow EOD — link will be in this thread.

Tara (Product): We'll own the severity buckets and add a "deploy safety checklist" item to roadmap.

Diego (Oncall): Canary started with extra tail-latency tracing: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingress/canary. First 3h look stable.

Sam (VP Eng): Action items summary: 1) Rohit — complete RCA + attach logs by 2026-03-27 2) Priya/Runtime — finish config rollback across regions by 2026-03-25 3) Jess — comms draft by EOD tomorrow 4) Product — severity mapping & checklist. Please react when done.

Rohit (SRE Lead): Note for engineers: grep snippet to find TTL regression traces: kubectl logs -l app=ingress-cache -n prod | grep -n "ttl_override" -C2

Jess (Customer Ops): Draft posted: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/cs/ingress-comm-draft — comments welcome.

Emilia (CEO): Thanks everyone. Two asks: 1) keep all follow-ups in this thread 2) confirm completed actions with reactions so we can close them out.

Sam (VP Eng): I'll ping owners in 48h for short status updates.

Rohit (SRE Lead): attaching missing log snippet now and updating RCA link.

Jess (Customer Ops): acked :+1: 

Diego (Oncall): canary still green at 12h. Will report 24h and 48h.

Emilia (CEO): closing for now — reopen if questions. Thanks!
